material.acceptance_criteria: A legend mapping each 目标类型 code to one ability() target (none, unit, point), cited to the reference map 6.88g or to a 6.88g data file path:line; codes with no source stay UNVERIFIED.
material.description: abilities_688g_perlevel.tsv carries the 目标类型 field as a bare number per level and the docs/ tree has no legend for it. Blocks every effect encoding for the 240 hero abilities, since an effect needs its ability target (blocks content-688g-ability-effect-mapping).

notes.note: Owner decision (user): maximise parity. The legend is 6.88g data; if 6.88g does not give it, keep UNVERIFIED. Do not invent it.
